hooks.command:
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)
case "$f" in
  */backend/*) dir=backend ;;
  */frontend/*) dir=frontend ;;
  *) exit 0 ;;
esac
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0
cd "$root/$dir" || exit 0
out=$(npm run type-check 2>&1)
code=$?
if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then
  jq -n --arg dir "$dir" --arg out "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("type-check failed in \($dir):\n\($out)")}}'
fi
exit 0
